cc:Work.dc:title: CiteTutor local architecture
cc:Work.dc:description: PDF ingestion and reviewed OCR feed local hybrid retrieval. Gemma drafts, code validates citations, Qwen blindly solves and checks support before display. Quiz candidates have a separate gate. Optional Sentry receives allowlisted operational metadata only.
